question: What happens if an insured person aged 65 or older makes a claim?
answer: If any Insured Person is 65 years of age or over on the date of commencement of the current Policy Year, then it is agreed that We will only pay 80% of any amount We assess for payment or reimbursement in respect of any claim made by that Insured Person and the balance will be borne by the Insured Person.
